open_findings.summary: Dark reading sections render their heading, list items, jump-card titles, chart axis/category/legend text and figure-tool labels in the background ink, at contrast ratios down to 1.0:1.
open_findings.evidence: qa/contrast-probe.json (20 sub-AA rendered pairs, identical in the frozen first build and the final build); qa/shots/read-agenda-1920x1080.png; qa/shots/read-visits-1920x1080.png
open_findings.root_cause: private/build/style.css: the rule [data-dv-page] [data-theme=dark] sets color:var(--ed-paper) while redefining --ed-paper:#172b3b in the SAME declaration block, so the custom property resolves on that element to the section background.
open_findings.exact_fix: In that rule use the literal colours (background:#172b3b; color:#f7f3e9) and give the dark surface a distinct token name, so the foreground no longer resolves against a redefined background token.
open_findings.why_not_fixed: Discovered during the third round's re-verification screenshots; the three permitted correction rounds were already consumed.
open_findings.why_the_scorers_missed_it: visual_qa_score.py pairs root-scope custom properties only, so a token redefined inside a theme block is invisible to it; measure_handbook.py and detect_visual_defects.py measure geometry, clipping and font size, not colour contrast. This is the documented 'a structural pass is not a visual pass' case.
open_findings.not_present_in: The presentation deck and the PPTX are unaffected; their dark slides render correctly (qa/shots/deck-s-visits-1920x1080.png, qa/pptx-frames/slide4.png).

open_findings.summary: At 1920x1080 the section partially visible below the hero at load renders at opacity 0.45; the binary rule is that every section's load-time entry state is fully legible.
open_findings.evidence: qa/harness-report.json behaviour.first_paint_min_opacity = 0.45 (it was 1 before round 3 shortened the hero and brought the next section into the first viewport)
open_findings.root_cause: The scroll-responsive reveal (animation-timeline: view(), keyframe ed-rise from opacity .45) is applied to section CONTENT.
open_findings.exact_fix: Move the scroll-driven animation off the content onto a decorative [data-dv-section]::before section rule that grows on scroll, leaving content at opacity 1 at all times.
open_findings.why_not_fixed: Introduced and detected in round 3; the correction budget was exhausted.
open_findings.mitigation_in_place: Under prefers-reduced-motion the animation is disabled entirely (verified: reduced_motion_hero_opaque = 1, no running animations), and the hero itself is excluded from the reveal.

open_findings.gate: installed-runtime defect (not repaired: installed skills must not be modified)
open_findings.summary: Closing Presentation Mode does not restore the reading scroll position. Scrolled to y=2000, opened the deck, pressed Escape: the page returns to y=0.
open_findings.reproduced_on_stock: Yes. A build with NO authored stylesheet and NO authored fragments, from the same builder, restored 1200 -> 17. The defect is in the installed runtime, not in this run's authoring.
open_findings.root_cause: close() calls window.scrollTo(0, scroll) in the same task in which documentElement.style.overflow is restored and the page element is unhidden; the scroll is clamped against the still-locked scrolling box. A manual window.scrollTo after settle reaches y=2000 correctly.
open_findings.exact_fix: Defer the restore by one frame (requestAnimationFrame) inside restoreReading(), or read a layout property to force a flush before scrolling.
open_findings.contract_reference: dual-view-handbooks.md 'Verify the delivered bytes' item 4: 'Closing presentation restores reading position and focus.' Focus restoration DOES work (focus_returned_to_opener = true); only scroll does not.

open_findings.summary: SKILL.md requires every data figure to offer 'zoom, pan, series toggle AND axis adjustment'. The installed retained chart renderer (dual_view.py render_chart) emits series toggle, a zoom range, a reset control and an exact-values table, but no axis-limit control.
open_findings.impact: Axis adjustment is unavailable on the retained-assembly path. Providing it would require authoring script into the output, which the retained-fragment contract forbids (fragments are passive markup only).
open_findings.verified_working: series toggle hides/restores marks, zoom scales the plot to 200%, reset restores, exact-values table renders 3 rows with the true source numbers.

open_findings.summary: The chart's midpoint gridline label renders as '10.0' rather than '10'. The installed renderer formats the computed midpoint (lower+upper)/2 as a float.
open_findings.impact: Cosmetic only; the value is correct and the exact-values table shows 10 / 15 / 20.
